title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 22
paragraphs: Miletus, then, had been stripped of its former inhabitants; but among the Samians, those who had means were by no means satisfied with what had been arranged by their fleet commanders with the Medes. Taking counsel right after the sea-fight, they resolved that, before their tyrant Aeaces arrived in the country, they would sail away and found a colony, and not stay behind and become slaves of the Medes and of Aeaces. For just at this time the people of Zancle in Sicily were sending messengers to Ionia inviting the Ionians to come to the “Fair Strand,” wishing to found a city of Ionians there. Now this so-called Fair Strand is in the land of the Sicels and on the side of Sicily that faces Tyrsenia. So when this invitation was given, the Samians alone of all the Ionians set out, having with them those of the Milesians who had escaped; and in the course of this matter it happened as follows.
